title: safebot
tagline: Safe telegram wallet with two factor authentication.
description:
This project enables users use safe smart wallet which provides extra security to interact with their favorite protocols on telegram.                                                             
It also allows users setup a recovery mechanism in case their EOA account becomes compromised.
how_its_made: This project is built using the gnosis safe sdk and grammy which is a javascript sdk for creating telegram bots. It basically allows users execute transactions through their safe wallets on telegram. The purpose of this project was to enable users have a unibot like experience but with extra security.
